name: Flex My Flame
description: Released in July 2023 as a single, "Flex My Flame" is the record where That Boy Hi Hat's swagger became a catalog cornerstone. The identical recording runs across three releases — the single and both albums — which tells you everything about its staying power: this is a foundational flex record that That Boy Hi Hat keeps returning to. Sonically it sits squarely in post trap and alt rap territory, built on an 808-driven low end that anchors the entire mix, hard-hitting drums, and crisp hi-hats that keep the pocket tight throughout. A synth-driven lead melody rides layered underneath the low end, with a bassline that rolls rather than stomps, and ad-libs stacked thick in the chorus for extra lift. The mix is polished without losing its bite — this is music engineered to sound expensive and dangerous at the same time. That Boy Hi Hat performs it with the confidence of an artist who has already decided the outcome: bars about self-belief as performance, delivery halfway between a boast and a promise. For fans of the genre's classic swagger records, "Flex My Flame" sounds like a coronation that never needed a ceremony. It recalls the great boast-as-craft tradition of hip hop while staying firmly in the vein of That Boy Hi Hat's post-trap futurism. As a July 2023 release that still holds its place on playlists like DJ 6Rings' "It's Goin," it remains one of That Boy Hi Hat's signature calling cards — energetic, confident, and built to last.
